sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·朗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 即使是在我那个黑胶唱片时代的夜店做DJ的时候，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你每天晚上都要带上300件你最珍视的宝贝去工作，把DJ台变成一个充满活力的快闪博物馆，展示着那些精美的、有50年历史的艺术品。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼带来的《重构者》吧。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, the country's biggest rainstorm in recorded history heads east, surprising and overwhelming the smaller towns of Texas.
sentences.zh: 今天，有记录以来该国最大的暴雨向东移动，令德克萨斯州的小城镇措手不及，损失惨重。

sentences.en: And it was built on the edge of a swampy bayou.
sentences.zh: 它建立在沼泽河口的边缘。

sentences.en: How, from the very beginning, Houston was made to flood.
sentences.zh: 休斯顿从一开始就是为了洪水而建的。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, August 31St.
sentences.zh: 今天是8月31日，星期四。

sentences.en: It's 10 o'clock.
sentences.zh: 现在是10点钟。

sentences.en: I'm dry.
sentences.zh: 我这里还没进水。

sentences.en: And I am really happy to report that my husband is with me and my dog.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴地告诉大家，我的丈夫和我的狗都和我在一起。

sentences.en: I've lived here for 30 years.
sentences.zh: 我在这里住了30年了。

sentences.en: This is the most rain I've ever seen.
sentences.zh: 这是我见过最大的雨。

sentences.en: It's crazy.
sentences.zh: 太疯狂了。

sentences.en: Please help.
sentences.zh: 请救救我们。

sentences.en: The water is getting up to our house.
sentences.zh: 水正漫向我们的房子。

sentences.en: We're more than eight feet in the water.
sentences.zh: 我们周围的水深超过了八英尺。

sentences.en: It's all surrounded.
sentences.zh: 我们被包围了。

sentences.en: We don't have a way out.
sentences.zh: 我们没法离开。

sentences.en: We have elders.
sentences.zh: 我们有老人。

sentences.en: We have kids.
sentences.zh: 我们有孩子。

sentences.en: We're hearing that they're going to come for us.
sentences.zh: 我们听说他们会来救我们。

sentences.en: Pray that our dams do not go.
sentences.zh: 祈祷我们的水坝不要决堤。

sentences.en: Because if the dams go, it's going to be really, really hard.
sentences.zh: 因为如果水坝决堤，情况会变得非常、非常艰难。

sentences.en: There's more water coming.
sentences.zh: 还有更多的水涌过来。

sentences.en: The problem starts for Houston almost the moment that it's founded.
sentences.zh: 休斯顿的问题几乎从它建立的那一刻就开始了。

sentences.en: Richard Fassett covers the South for The Times.
sentences.zh: 理查德·法塞特为《时报》报道南部新闻。

sentences.en: In the late 1830s, the city was founded by a pair of brothers, two New York real estate speculators, founded the city of Houston on the banks of a rather muddy bayou.
sentences.zh: 19世纪30年代末，这座城市由一对兄弟，也就是两位纽约房地产投机商，在一条相当泥泞的河口岸边建立了休斯顿市。

sentences.en: So this is built on, essentially, like a swamp.
sentences.zh: 所以，它本质上是建在沼泽地上的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's an extremely flat part of the world.
sentences.zh: 这是一个极其平坦的地区。

sentences.en: Of course, it's in the path of hurricanes every year.
sentences.zh: 当然，它每年都在飓风的路径上。

sentences.en: And almost as soon as Houston was founded, it suffered a major flood that inundated every structure in the young city.
sentences.zh: 而且休斯顿几乎刚一建立，就遭遇了一场大洪水，淹没了这座年轻城市里的每一座建筑。

sentences.en: From there, it suffered about 100 floods for the next century.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，在接下来的一个世纪里，它又遭遇了大约100次洪水。

sentences.en: And it has been struggling from its very inception to deal with the bad hands that geography and fate have dealt it.
sentences.zh: 从诞生之初，它就一直在努力应对地理环境和命运给它发的这手烂牌。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: It's one of the most difficult places to build a boomtown you can think of.
sentences.zh: 这是你能想到的最难建立繁荣城市的地方之一。

sentences.en: The city of Houston is booming.
sentences.zh: 休斯顿市正在蓬勃发展。

sentences.en: After the Second World War, you started seeing massive growth in the 1950s, and particularly the 1960s.
sentences.zh: 二战后，你在20世纪50年代，尤其是60年代，看到了大规模的增长。

sentences.en: And so the growth just kept coming and coming and coming.
sentences.zh: 所以这种增长一直持续不断。

sentences.en: Houston is a great place to do business.
sentences.zh: 休斯顿是一个做生意的好地方。

sentences.en: Anyone will tell you that.
sentences.zh: 任何人都会这么告诉你。

sentences.en: So Houston, at this point in its development, is lots of things.
sentences.zh: 所以，休斯顿在目前的发展阶段，拥有多重身份。

sentences.en: It's a port town.
sentences.zh: 它是一个港口城市。

sentences.en: It's an arts and cultural hub.
sentences.zh: 它是一个艺术和文化中心。

sentences.en: It's a banking center.
sentences.zh: 它是一个银行中心。

sentences.en: We have never had a development and business community so broad, so robust, and so diverse.
sentences.zh: 我们从未拥有过如此广泛、稳健和多元的发展与商业社区。

sentences.en: But at its core, it's an oil and gas town.
sentences.zh: 但其核心，它是一个石油和天然气城市。

sentences.en: And it's that petrochemical industry that has just been crucial to its growth for many, many years.
sentences.zh: 正是这种石油化工产业，多年来对其增长至关重要。

sentences.en: The Houston business climate is very strong.
sentences.zh: 休斯顿的商业环境非常强劲。

sentences.en: Houston's been able to weather the ups and downs of the national and global economies through a strong tie to the oil and gas business.
sentences.zh: 通过与石油和天然气业务的紧密联系，休斯顿得以度过国家和全球经济的起起落落。

sentences.en: And there's been a number of urban theorists who've looked to Houston as a real model for the way a city should work.
sentences.zh: 有很多城市理论家将休斯顿视为城市运作模式的真正典范。

sentences.en: Developers kind of run the place, and there's not much tolerance for regulation in a way that you find along the coasts or in a place like California.
sentences.zh: 开发商几乎掌控着这个地方，而且这里对监管的容忍度很低，这与你在沿海地区或加利福尼亚等地所见的情况不同。

sentences.en: All right, no city in the United States is growing faster in population than Houston.
sentences.zh: 好吧，美国没有任何城市的人口增长速度超过休斯顿。

sentences.en: Harris County, Texas, of which Houston is a part, was the fastest growing county in the United States for something like eight of the last nine years.
sentences.zh: 德克萨斯州的哈里斯县（休斯顿所在地）在过去九年里有大约八年是美国人口增长最快的县。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国人口普查局表示，休斯顿所在的哈里斯县增加了超过9万人，领先全国。

sentences.en: Census Bureau says Houston, Harris County, led the nation by adding more than 90,000 people.
sentences.zh: 美国人口普查局表示，休斯顿所在的哈里斯县增加了超过9万人，领先全国。

sentences.en: Richard, what you're describing is kind of a boomtown that is growing despite this kind of watery underbelly that would seem like an incredible risk.
sentences.zh: 理查德，你所描述的是一种尽管存在这种看似巨大风险的“水下隐患”，却仍在增长的繁荣城市。

sentences.en: That's true.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And for people who lived in greater Houston, they had been receiving signals that something like this might happen for a few years.
sentences.zh: 对于居住在大休斯顿地区的人们来说，他们几年来一直收到信号，表明可能会发生这样的事情。

sentences.en: The catastrophic aftermath of record-breaking deadly floodwaters in Houston, Texas, revealed this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上揭示了德克萨斯州休斯顿破纪录的致命洪水所带来的灾难性后果。

sentences.en: On Memorial Day of 2015, they suffered a very bad flood.
sentences.zh: 2015年的阵亡将士纪念日，他们遭遇了一场非常严重的洪水。

sentences.en: Well, the storm's death toll continuing to climb today with the discovery of six victiMs.
sentences.zh: 风暴的死亡人数今天随着六名遇难者的发现而继续攀升。

sentences.en: The next year, what was called the Tax Day Flood in April 2016, another devastating flood.
sentences.zh: 第二年，也就是2016年4月，发生了所谓的“税日洪水”，又是一场毁灭性的洪水。

sentences.en: It's been a staggering week of flooding.
sentences.zh: 这是一个令人震惊的洪水周。

sentences.en: Eight people have died, some trapped in their cars, submerged in the fast-rising water.
sentences.zh: 八人死亡，一些人被困在车里，淹没在快速上涨的水中。

sentences.en: Officials say more than 240 billion gallons of rain have fallen on the Houston area.
sentences.zh: 官员们表示，休斯顿地区降雨量超过2400亿加仑。

sentences.en: That's enough to fill more than 360,000 Olympic-sized pools.
sentences.zh: 这足以填满超过36万个奥林匹克标准游泳池。

sentences.en: And the city has been, for the last few years, been trying to figure out what it's done wrong.
sentences.zh: 过去几年，这座城市一直在试图弄清楚自己做错了什么。

sentences.en: After World War II in the 1950s and 60s, you saw the beginning of really serious urban and suburban growth.
sentences.zh: 二战后，在20世纪50年代和60年代，你看到了真正严重的城市和郊区增长的开始。

sentences.en: And two of the many bayous that crisscrossed greater Houston were channelized.
sentences.zh: 横跨大休斯顿地区的许多河口中的两条被渠道化了。

sentences.en: They were basically turned into massive concrete culverts.
sentences.zh: 它们基本上变成了巨大的混凝土涵洞。

sentences.en: And there was a thought at the time that this would help with the drainage flow.
sentences.zh: 当时人们认为这有助于排水。

sentences.en: And there was robust building along their banks and all around.
sentences.zh: 而且在它们的河岸和周围进行了大量的建设。

sentences.en: But by the 1980s, a number of other really bad storm events led people to realize that they basically didn't know what they were doing.
sentences.zh: 但到了20世纪80年代，其他一些非常严重的风暴事件让人们意识到，他们基本上不知道自己在做什么。

sentences.en: And that the system they built just wasn't working.
sentences.zh: 而且他们建立的系统根本不起作用。

sentences.en: The development had paved over the wetlands and the prairies.
sentences.zh: 开发项目覆盖了湿地和草原。

sentences.en: And they began to fear that they were making the problem worse.
sentences.zh: 他们开始担心自己正在加剧这个问题。

sentences.en: Plenty of people have been looking for someone or something to blame.
sentences.zh: 很多人一直在寻找可以责怪的人或事。

sentences.en: So just why does Houston keep flooding?
sentences.zh: 那么，为什么休斯顿一直被淹？

sentences.en: Yeah, well now we have learned that one of the problems is right beneath our feet.
sentences.zh: 是的，现在我们了解到，问题之一就在我们脚下。

sentences.en: One of the areas where Houston is seeing a lot of development right now is an area on the northwestern flank of greater Houston, known as the Katy Prairie.
sentences.zh: 休斯顿目前正在进行大量开发的地区之一是大休斯顿西北侧的一个区域，被称为凯蒂草原。

sentences.en: There is a place where icons still roam and ranching and farming heritage are tightly bound.
sentences.zh: 那是一个偶像依然漫步、牧场和农业遗产紧密相连的地方。

sentences.en: Once upon a time, this had been a long grass prairie that had absorbed a lot of the rainwater from a major event like this.
sentences.zh: 曾经，这里是一片长草草原，吸收了像这样重大事件带来的大量雨水。

sentences.en: These days, it's full of strip malls and schools and convenience stores and malls.
sentences.zh: 如今，这里到处都是露天购物中心、学校、便利店和商场。

sentences.en: The future looks bright for the city of Katy, which is partly why residents may soon be getting a brand new multi-million dollar convention center.
sentences.zh: 凯蒂市的未来看起来很光明，这也是为什么居民们可能很快就会拥有一个全新的、耗资数百万美元的会议中心的原因之一。

sentences.en: Tell us about what kind of economic development is happening today in Katy, Texas.
sentences.zh: 告诉我们今天在德克萨斯州凯蒂市正在发生什么样的经济发展。

sentences.en: Well, real estate is huge.
sentences.zh: 嗯，房地产规模巨大。

sentences.en: Things are still booming.
sentences.zh: 一切仍在蓬勃发展。

sentences.en: Land is abundant.
sentences.zh: 土地资源丰富。

sentences.en: Check out this Buc-ee's car wash in Katy.
sentences.zh: 看看凯蒂市这个Buc-ee's洗车店吧。

sentences.en: Katy is planning to be the world's largest or longest car wash there.
sentences.zh: 凯蒂计划在那里建设世界上最大或最长的洗车店。

sentences.en: And the water that used to pool up in the grasslands now basically has nowhere to go.
sentences.zh: 而过去汇集在草原上的水，现在基本上无处可去。

sentences.en: This 80-acre pond seems like it's in the middle of a sweeping Texas prairie.
sentences.zh: 这个80英亩的池塘看起来就像在广阔的德克萨斯草原中间。

sentences.en: But it's in the middle of Katy, next to homes and the mall.
sentences.zh: 但它位于凯蒂市中心，紧邻住宅和商场。

sentences.en: And it's where the city is hoping to build a boardwalk, a 55,000-square-foot convention center.
sentences.zh: 这也是该市希望建造木板路和55000平方英尺会议中心的地方。

sentences.en: The city owns the lake.
sentences.zh: 这个湖归市政府所有。

sentences.en: And so what happens when it rains and the water hits those areas?
sentences.zh: 那么当下雨，水流到这些区域时会发生什么？

sentences.en: Well, what happens is what we've seen on television.
sentences.zh: 嗯，发生的事情就是我们在电视上看到的那些。

sentences.en: Houston got no break today from relentless storMs.
sentences.zh: 休斯顿今天在无情的风暴中没有得到任何喘息的机会。

sentences.en: Heavy rains kept rivers and creeks swollen.
sentences.zh: 大雨使河流和小溪持续暴涨。

sentences.en: Houston, let's keep it real.
sentences.zh: 休斯顿，让我们面对现实吧。

sentences.en: Our concrete jungle with all the pavement makes for a nightmare scenario when Mother Nature turns nasty.
sentences.zh: 当大自然变得恶劣时，我们那铺满路面的混凝土丛林就成了噩梦般的场景。

sentences.en: When rain falls, it has nowhere to go.
sentences.zh: 当雨水落下时，它无处可去。

sentences.en: Nowhere to go except into neighborhood streets and people's homes.
sentences.zh: 除了流进社区街道和人们的家中，无处可去。

sentences.en: The metro area's development has exploded, replacing soil-rich wetlands that could absorb water with concrete-covered suburbia.
sentences.zh: 大都市区的开发呈爆炸式增长，用混凝土覆盖的郊区取代了可以吸收水分的富含土壤的湿地。

sentences.en: Wetlands and prairie lands are really important.
sentences.zh: 湿地和草原非常重要。

sentences.en: They're nature's way of absorbing floodwaters.
sentences.zh: 它们是大自然吸收洪水的方式。

sentences.en: They allow the water to percolate and filter down into the soil as opposed to just running off the way they would if they hit a Walmart parking lot.
sentences.zh: 它们让水渗入并过滤到土壤中，而不是像流向沃尔玛停车场那样直接流走。

sentences.en: And they also serve to delay the movement of water in some cases.
sentences.zh: 它们在某些情况下还可以起到延缓水流的作用。

sentences.en: So the more concrete you pour, the more you have to deal with fast-moving water.
sentences.zh: 所以你浇筑的混凝土越多，你就越需要应对快速流动的水。

sentences.en: So every bit of this kind of open land that is taken away potentially causes a lot more problems down the line.
sentences.zh: 因此，每一块被占用的开阔土地都可能在未来导致更多的问题。

sentences.en: Richard, what kind of zoning is there?
sentences.zh: 理查德，那里有什么样的分区规划？

sentences.en: And I guess we should define that word, but the notion that there's a pretty centralized system of thinking about what gets built and where and rules that govern it.
sentences.zh: 我想我们应该定义一下这个词，但那种认为对于什么地方该建什么、以及管理它的规则有一套相当集中的思考系统的概念。

sentences.en: So the city of Houston famously or infamously doesn't have zoning the way most cities do.
sentences.zh: 所以，休斯顿市以没有大多数城市那样的分区规划而闻名，或者说臭名昭著。

sentences.en: And so one of the hallmarks of Houston life within the city is the sort of block that has the strip joint next to the Baptist church next to the Quickie Mart.
sentences.zh: 因此，休斯顿市内生活的一个标志就是那种街区，旁边有脱衣舞俱乐部，接着是浸信会教堂，再旁边是便利店。

sentences.en: So this idea that Houston is not zoned is relevant to the disaster unfolding in that it reflects a kind of laissez-faire and libertarian streak in Texas consciousness.
sentences.zh: 所以，休斯顿没有分区规划的这种想法与正在发生的灾难有关，因为它反映了德克萨斯人意识中一种自由放任和自由意志主义的倾向。

sentences.en: But really the broader issue is that greater Houston now encompasses so much more than the city of Houston itself.
sentences.zh: 但真正更广泛的问题是，大休斯顿现在涵盖的范围远不止休斯顿市本身。

sentences.en: There's this patchwork of town governments and city governments and county governments.
sentences.zh: 这里有一套由城镇政府、市政府和县政府组成的拼凑系统。

sentences.en: Flood water doesn't care what municipality you live in.
sentences.zh: 洪水可不管你住在哪个行政区。

sentences.en: So you can have a poorly planned neighborhood 10 miles from you that may be the reason why your house in the city of Houston is flooding.
sentences.zh: 所以你可能在离你10英里远的地方有一个规划不善的社区，这可能是你位于休斯顿市的房子被淹的原因。

sentences.en: And there's very little you can do about it.
sentences.zh: 而且你对此几乎无能为力。

sentences.en: Just how irresponsible has this building and planning been?
sentences.zh: 这种建设和规划到底有多不负责任？

sentences.en: I mean it feels like this had to have been some sort of a calculation about you know the economic benefits of just letting a place grow really fast
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这似乎是一种计算，关于让一个地方快速发展的经济利益，

sentences.en: versus an awareness that it could all come home to rooSt.
sentences.zh: 而不是意识到这一切可能会带来恶果。

sentences.en: Well people have been grappling with it and ringing alarm bells for many many years especially as the surface of the oceans has been warming
sentences.zh: 嗯，人们多年来一直在努力应对这个问题并敲响警钟，特别是在海洋表面温度不断升高的情况下，

sentences.en: and potentially creating much stronger, much wetter, much more powerful and much more damaging storMs.
sentences.zh: 这可能会产生更强、更湿、更有威力、破坏力更大的风暴。

sentences.en: The problem is that Houston's success in so many ways is based on the fact that it's just decided to go and go and grow limitlessly.
sentences.zh: 问题在于，休斯顿在许多方面的成功是基于它决定无限期地增长。

sentences.en: That means you can buy a house for very little money.
sentences.zh: 这意味着你可以用很少的钱买到房子。

sentences.en: And this has really been one of the main reasons why it's been so difficult to put a brake on all the construction.
sentences.zh: 这确实是很难给所有建设踩刹车的主要原因之一。

sentences.en: You mentioned the idea of people raising alarm bells and I want to just talk about that for a minute.
sentences.zh: 你提到了人们敲响警钟的想法，我想谈谈这一点。

sentences.en: There was in the case of Katrina an incredible amount of ominous writing and debating in retrospect about the risks.
sentences.zh: 在卡特里娜飓风的案例中，事后有大量关于风险的警告性文章和辩论。

sentences.en: Is that something you're finding has already happened in Houston?
sentences.zh: 这是你在休斯顿发现已经发生的事情吗？

sentences.en: Yes, this debate has been very vigorous in Houston.
sentences.zh: 是的，这场辩论在休斯顿非常激烈。

sentences.en: The alarm bells have been rung by all kinds of people by hydrologists, by urban planners, by environmentalists.
sentences.zh: 各种各样的人，包括水文学家、城市规划者、环保主义者，都敲响了警钟。

sentences.en: The human development is what's really driving and exacerbating flood losses over time.
sentences.zh: 人类的发展才是真正推动和加剧洪水损失的因素。

sentences.en: Now very often by people living in neighborhoods that weren't flooding just three or four years ago but are now flooding over and over and over again.
sentences.zh: 现在，经常是那些住在三四年前还没被淹，但现在却反复被淹的社区的人们在敲响警钟。

sentences.en: And so what happens now?
sentences.zh: 那么现在会发生什么？

sentences.en: How does all of this affect the aftermath and the recovery from the storm?
sentences.zh: 这一切如何影响风暴后的余波和恢复？

sentences.en: Well, much like in the aftermath of Hurricane Katrina, you have people talking now about neighborhoods that perhaps shouldn't come back.
sentences.zh: 嗯，就像卡特里娜飓风之后一样，现在有人在谈论那些也许不应该重建的社区。

sentences.en: As we know from Katrina, this can be a very contentious process.
sentences.zh: 正如我们从卡特里娜飓风中所知，这可能是一个非常有争议的过程。

sentences.en: It can be very ugly.
sentences.zh: 它可能非常丑陋。

sentences.en: It's incredibly wrenching.
sentences.zh: 这令人极其痛苦。

sentences.en: Very, yeah, it's very hard to do.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实，这很难做到。

sentences.en: Once you've built a community, you can't really unbuild it.
sentences.zh: 一旦你建立了一个社区，你就无法真正拆除它。

sentences.en: But there is an optimistic strain right now in the response to Harvey.
sentences.zh: 但在应对哈维飓风的过程中，现在有一种乐观的倾向。

sentences.en: There are a lot of people who look at Houston and its tradition of oil patch geniuses and look at it as the place that put a man on the moon
sentences.zh: 有很多人看着休斯顿及其石油工业天才的传统，将其视为将人类送上月球的地方，

sentences.en: and look at it as a place that's leaning ever forward and thinking about the future and thinking that they might be able to engineer their way out of this.
sentences.zh: 并将其视为一个不断向前看、思考未来，并认为他们也许能够通过工程手段摆脱困境的地方。

sentences.en: There's a force that you can feel right now.
sentences.zh: 你现在能感受到一股力量。

sentences.en: People are pulling together.
sentences.zh: 人们正在团结起来。

sentences.en: And a lot of people think that not only will Houston come through this, but perhaps even think their way out of this.
sentences.zh: 很多人认为，休斯顿不仅能挺过这次难关，甚至可能通过思考找到出路。

sentences.en: Could Houston have become the city that it is, the fourth largest in the country,
sentences.zh: 休斯顿能成为如今这个全美第四大城市，

sentences.en: with the kind of growth it's experienced, without taking these risks?
sentences.zh: 经历如此迅猛的发展，而又不冒这些风险吗？

sentences.en: Well, this is a great question.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是一个很好的问题。

sentences.en: And this is a question that's much bigger than Houston.
sentences.zh: 而且这个问题远不止休斯顿一地的问题。

sentences.en: It's a question that urban theorists are talking about all the time.
sentences.zh: 这是城市理论家们一直在探讨的问题。

sentences.en: If you place limits on growth,
sentences.zh: 如果你限制城市发展，

sentences.en: then you have fewer homes very often.
sentences.zh: 那么住房往往就会变少。

sentences.en: If you have fewer homes, they become more expensive.
sentences.zh: 如果住房变少，房价就会变得更贵。

sentences.en: And that forces people out.
sentences.zh: 这会把人们挤出城市。

sentences.en: And if you're a working class person or a middle class person, if you're a welder or you own a little store, if you're a recent immigrant,
sentences.zh: 如果你是工薪阶层或中产阶级，如果你是一名焊工或经营一家小店，如果你是新移民，

sentences.en: or if you're a longtime resident of the United States who would really be struggling to get by in the San Francisco's of the world,
sentences.zh: 或者如果你是长期居住在美国、在旧金山那样的城市里苦苦挣扎的人，

sentences.en: in Houston, you have a place.
sentences.zh: 在休斯顿，你总有一席之地。

sentences.en: And the people who look at Houston as a great model for not only the American present, but the American future,
sentences.zh: 那些将休斯顿视为美国现在乃至未来典范的人，

sentences.en: say that the untrammeled growth was a big part of that.
sentences.zh: 认为不受束缚的发展是其中的重要原因。

sentences.en: It's allowed people to pursue the American dream and have a stake.
sentences.zh: 它让人们能够追求美国梦，并拥有属于自己的一份资产。

sentences.en: You have a place to set up.
sentences.zh: 你有地方可以安家。

sentences.en: You have a home.
sentences.zh: 你有一个家。

sentences.en: Richard, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 理查德，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: See you back.
sentences.zh: 回头见。

sentences.en: Okay, bye.
sentences.zh: 好的，再见。

sentences.en: As The Sun finally came out in Houston on Wednesday, after nearly a week of pounding rain, the storm traveled east across more than 300 towns and cities in rural Texas
sentences.zh: 周三，休斯顿终于拨云见日，在经历了近一周的暴雨后，风暴向东移动，席卷了德克萨斯州农村地区的300多个城镇，

sentences.en: and toward the Louisiana state line, with flooding and rain reaching up to 47 inches.
sentences.zh: 并向路易斯安那州州界推进，降雨量高达47英寸，引发了洪水。

sentences.en: While we are dealing with what is now receding waters in Harris County and the ongoing evacuation as well as safety rescue process in Harris County,
sentences.zh: 虽然我们正在处理哈里斯县目前正在消退的洪水，以及正在进行的疏散和安全救援工作，

sentences.en: we're now also dealing with catastrophic conditions in southeast Texas.
sentences.zh: 但我们现在也面临着德克萨斯州东南部灾难性的状况。

sentences.en: The governor, Greg Abbott, said the state would immediately deploy far more members of the National Guard to southeast Texas.
sentences.zh: 州长格雷格·阿博特表示，该州将立即向德克萨斯州东南部部署更多的国民警卫队队员。

sentences.en: The worst is not yet over for southeast Texas as far as the rain is concerned.
sentences.zh: 就降雨而言，德克萨斯州东南部的最坏情况尚未结束。

sentences.en: There will be ongoing challenges both during the time that rain continues to fall as well as for approximately four days to a week to come.
sentences.zh: 在降雨持续期间，以及未来大约四天到一周的时间里，挑战将持续存在。

sentences.en: Specifically, flooding conditions that will continue to be a challenge for people in the area.
sentences.zh: 具体来说，洪水状况将继续成为该地区民众面临的挑战。

sentences.en: Police in Beaumont, Texas, said they had received more than 700 calls for rescue and departments there were overwhelmed by the need for help.
sentences.zh: 德克萨斯州博蒙特的警方表示，他们已经接到了700多个求救电话，当地部门因需求过大而不堪重负。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, a toddler was rescued in the waters there, clinging to the body of her 41-year-old mother.
sentences.zh: 周三，一名幼儿在水中获救，当时她紧紧抓着她41岁母亲的遗体。

sentences.en: By the end of the day, the number of deaths attributed to the storm had reached at least 38.
sentences.zh: 到当天结束时，因这场风暴导致的死亡人数已至少达到38人。

sentences.en: Had a quick check of my home.
sentences.zh: 刚快速检查了一下我的家。

sentences.en: Looks like we've got four feet of water, three and a half feet of water.
sentences.zh: 看起来我们这儿有四英尺深的水，三英尺半深的水。

sentences.en: Just a lake in here.
sentences.zh: 这里简直成了一个湖。

sentences.en: A little bit over knee high right now.
sentences.zh: 现在水深已经没过膝盖了。

sentences.en: In the neighboring town of Port Arthur, the mayor, Derek Freeman, posted a video on Facebook as he toured his own flooded living room.
sentences.zh: 在邻近的阿瑟港，市长德里克·弗里曼在巡视自己被淹的客厅时，在Facebook上发布了一段视频。

sentences.en: But we're going to rebuild, Port Arthur.
sentences.zh: 但我们要重建，阿瑟港。

sentences.en: This isn't the end.
sentences.zh: 这不是终点。

sentences.en: This is just the beginning.
sentences.zh: 这仅仅是个开始。

sentences.en: This is the post and pre-moment.
sentences.zh: 这是灾后与灾前的分水岭。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Pray for our city.
sentences.zh: 为我们的城市祈祷吧。

sentences.en: We got some water, y'all.
sentences.zh: 我们这儿进水了，各位。

sentences.en: Harvey wasn't going in.
sentences.zh: 哈维没打算停下。

sentences.en: When an emergency shelter in Port Arthur itself started flooding, a bowling alley was transformed into a refuge for about 500 people.
sentences.zh: 当阿瑟港当地的一个紧急避难所开始被淹时，一家保龄球馆被改造成了约500人的避难所。

sentences.en: The shelter started to flood around 1 a.m., maybe 2.
sentences.zh: 避难所大约在凌晨1点或2点开始进水。

sentences.en: It almost looks like something out of a movie.
sentences.zh: 这看起来简直像电影里的场景。

sentences.en: It doesn't seem like it's something that's real.
sentences.zh: 这看起来一点都不真实。

sentences.en: Officials worry that many places in the region are inaccessible by car or boat.
sentences.zh: 官员们担心该地区的许多地方无法通过汽车或船只进入。

sentences.en: Crystal Holmes, a captain of the county sheriff's department, told the Times, for every rescue accomplished, there seem to be more who need help.
sentences.zh: 县治安官部门的队长克里斯托·霍姆斯告诉《泰晤士报》，每完成一次救援，似乎就有更多人需要帮助。

sentences.en: We are just as devastated as the Houston area, she said.
sentences.zh: 她说，我们和休斯顿地区一样遭受了重创。

sentences.en: We have so many citizens that are trapped inside their homes.
sentences.zh: 我们有太多的市民被困在家里。

sentences.en: Eventually, we will get to them.
sentences.zh: 最终，我们会找到他们。

sentences.en: But we just don't know if we're going to be able to get to them in time.
sentences.zh: 但我们只是不知道能否及时赶到他们身边。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: We're here today to launch our plans to bring back Main Street by reducing the crushing tax burden on our companies and on our workers.
sentences.zh: 我们今天来到这里，是为了启动我们的计划，通过减轻公司和工人的沉重税收负担，让主街重现活力。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, President Trump began laying out his plan to overhaul the U.S.
sentences.zh: 周三，特朗普总统开始阐述他改革美国税法的计划，

sentences.en: tax code, saying it would include cuts for businesses, investors, and the wealthiest, as well as reductions for the middle class.
sentences.zh: 称其将包括为企业、投资者和最富有的人减税，同时也为中产阶级减税。

sentences.en: That is why tax reform must dramatically simplify the tax code, eliminate special interest loopholes.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么税制改革必须大幅简化税法，消除特殊利益集团的漏洞。

sentences.en: And I'm speaking against myself when I do this, I have to tell you.
sentences.zh: 我得告诉你，我在说这话时其实是在反对我自己。

sentences.en: The president, who has admitted to paying little or no federal income taxes for years, said he wants to eliminate the kind of tax breaks that have benefited him.
sentences.zh: 这位曾承认多年来几乎没有缴纳或未缴纳联邦所得税的总统表示，他希望消除那些曾让他受益的税收优惠。

sentences.en: It's crazy.
sentences.zh: 这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: We're speaking, maybe we shouldn't be doing this, you know.
sentences.zh: 我们正在谈论这个，也许我们不该这么做，你知道的。

sentences.en: But we're doing the right thing.
sentences.zh: 但我们正在做正确的事。

sentences.en: Trump urged Congress to quickly adopt his plan.
sentences.zh: 特朗普敦促国会尽快通过他的计划。

sentences.en: But the Times reports that after months of private negotiations with House and Senate leaders, his administration has yet to draft the legislation.
sentences.zh: 但《泰晤士报》报道称，在与众议院和参议院领导人进行了数月的私下谈判后，他的政府尚未起草相关法案。

sentences.en: So this is our once-in-a-generation opportunity to deliver real tax reform for everyday, hard-working Americans.
sentences.zh: 所以，这是我们一代人一次的机会，为每天辛勤工作的美国人带来真正的税制改革。

sentences.en: And I am fully committed to working with Congress to get this job done.
sentences.zh: 我完全致力于与国会合作完成这项工作。

sentences.en: And I don't want to be disappointed by Congress.
sentences.zh: 我不想对国会感到失望。

sentences.en: Do you understand me?
sentences.zh: 你明白我的意思吗？

sentences.en: Do you understand?
sentences.zh: 你明白吗？

sentences.en: Understand, Congress.
sentences.zh: 明白了吗，国会。

sentences.en: I think Congress is going to make a comeback.
sentences.zh: 我认为国会将会卷土重来。

sentences.en: I hope so.
sentences.zh: 我希望如此。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是今天的《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbari.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴里。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。
